summary: Master project scheduling and cost planning with our expert-led training course. Gain essential skills to elevate your project management career today!
lede: Project scheduling and cost planning training helps project professionals build and control integrated timelines and budgets. It covers creating work breakdown structures, estimating costs, calculating critical paths, and allocating resources, then establishing baselines and tracking performance with earned value measures. Practical exercises apply these methods to forecast completion, assess risks and contingencies, manage changes, and communicate schedule and cost variances.
audienceIntro: This program is engineered for professionals responsible for forecasting, tracking, and controlling project resources and timelines.
modules: Schedule Development and Critical Path Method
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of general project lifecycles and basic spreadsheet navigation. No advanced coding or specialized software experience is required, as all exercises utilize accessible digital templates and standard frameworks.
